about: The quest tracker's data (QoL 3, main lane, chat 37). Read from the game's own ECL scripts: City Hall's commission list and report loop (ECL3 block 8: offers 0xA845-0xAF4B, reports 0x9D0E-0x9F76) and every field event that writes a report flag (the lab's writers index). A quest is a set of conditions on ECL memory; scripts/game/quest_log.gd evaluates them. Nothing here is shown by the original: the tracker is an addition (QoL).
conditions: Each condition is a string. 'ADDR OP VALUE' compares the byte at ECL address ADDR (hex); OP is one of == != >= <= > <. 'ADDR & MASK' holds when all of MASK's bits are set. 'shown A:B ADDR' holds when the engine has shown the text at ECL area A:B address ADDR (the tracker records it: offers that set no flag). A list of conditions holds when all hold.

report_values.254: done in the field: the City Council's clerk pays the reward at the next City Hall visit

tally.meaning: the council's count of major successes (one per reported Norris, Sokal Keep, Podol Plaza, the graveyard, Kovel Mansion, the river, the lizardmen, the kobolds, the nomads, the slums); at 4 or more the graveyard commission is offered (0xA592)

quests.title: Clear the Slums
quests.offer: THE SLUMS IMMEDIATELY TO OUR WEST NEED TO BE CLEARED OF MONSTERS.

steps.text: Fights won in the Slums (the script counts them)

quests.report: YOUR CLEARING OF THE SLUM AREAS PERMITS US TO EXPAND.

quests.title: Clear Sokal Keep
quests.where: 4:21 Sokal Keep, on Thorn Island (by boat from the harbor master)
quests.offer: SOKAL KEEP ON THORN ISLAND MUST BE CLEARED.
quests.done_text: Ferran's ghosts are freed ('NOW WE ARE FREED, OUR DUTY DONE!', 4:21 0xADAA)
quests.report: WITH SOKAL KEEP IN OUR HANDS, WE CAN USE BOATS TO BYPASS THE BARREN RIVER.
quests.note: Reported, it opens three more commissions: the Bishop's summons, Kovel Mansion and the Bivant heir.

quests.title: Books and records of old Phlan
quests.where: 2:15 Mendor's library (and wherever such papers are found)
quests.offer: THE COUNCIL IS OFFERING A REWARD FOR BOOKS, MAPS, TOMES, ETC. WHICH PROVIDE USEFUL INFORMATION ABOUT PHLAN BEFORE THE FALL.

steps.text: The discourses
The descriptions
steps.report: THE COUNCIL WILL BE AMUSED BY THE DESCRIPTIONS.

steps.text: The maps
steps.report: THESE MAPS SHOULD HELP US TO LOCATE SEVERAL LEGENDARY BUILDINGS.

steps.text: The histories
steps.report: THESE HISTORIES CONTAIN MUCH USEFUL INFORMATION.

steps.text: The records
steps.report: THE RECORDS PROVIDE INSIGHTS INTO MUCH THAT WAS PUZZLING.

steps.text: A minor work
steps.report: THIS MATERIAL IS OF SMALL VALUE.

quests.note: Six documents, each its own report flag (0x4AAA-0x4AAF, written in 2:15). The council stops offering it once the library is cleared and paid for (4AC2 = 255, next quest); documents found later are still paid.

quests.title: Clear the library

steps.text: The spectre that guards the books is destroyed
The reptilian monster is killed

quests.report: 'THERE IS A REWARD FOR CLEARING THE LIBRARY.'

quests.title: The auction at Podol Plaza
quests.offer: A WEAPON OF GREAT POWER IS TO BE AUCTIONED TO OUR ENEMIES. THIS AUCTION IS TO BE HELD IN PODAL PLAZA.  FIND OUT WHAT THE WEAPON IS AND RETURN.
quests.done_text: the auction is over or cancelled (1:18 0xA82B, 0xA86B)
quests.report: YOUR SUCCESS AT PODAL PLAZA IS NOTED.

quests.title: Clear Podol Plaza
quests.report: 'THERE IS A REWARD FOR CLEARING THE PODAL PLAZA.'

quests.title: Cadorna's family treasure
quests.giver: Junior Councilman Cadorna (City Hall, the east door)
quests.where: 4:2 the Cadorna textile house, south of Podol Plaza
quests.offer: JUNIOR COUNCILMAN CADORNA HAS A SPECIAL COMMISSION FOR YOU.  HIS CHAMBERS ARE THROUGH THE EAST DOOR.

steps.text: Cadorna tells of the treasure hidden in the textile house's western building
The city watch takes the treasure at New Phlan's gateway

quests.report: COUNCILMAN CADORNA LEFT THIS PAYMENT FOR SOME SERVICE YOU HAD RENDERED.
quests.note: Clearing the textile house pays separately ('THE CADORNA TEXTILE HOUSE', 4AE6: 254 cleared, 255 paid); it is not needed for the treasure (c34d took the treasure with 4AE6 = 0).

quests.title: Cleanse the temple of Bane
quests.giver: Bishop Braccio of Tyr (Tyr's temple, New Phlan), after Sokal Keep is reported
quests.offer: YOU ARE SUMMONED BY THE BISHOP OF BRACCIO OF TYR. REPORT TO HIM AT TYR'S TEMPLE.

steps.text: Dirten, priest of Ilmater, goes with the party
The orcs in the building next to the temple are dealt with (a reward of its own)
The temple's treasure is found and its defenders beaten

quests.report: CONGRATULATIONS, YOU MAY KEEP ALL YOU FOUND IN THE TEMPLE OF BANE AS A REWARD.
quests.note: The area next to the temple reports on its own: 'YOU HAVE CLEARED THE AREA NEXT TO THE EVIL TEMPLE.' (4AA8).

quests.title: The thieves of Kovel Mansion
quests.giver: City Council, after Sokal Keep is reported
quests.offer: A LARGE GROUP OF THIEVES OPERATES OUT OF THE OLD KOVEL MANSION. THE COUNCIL WILL PAY TO HAVE THEM CLEANED OUT.
quests.report: THE COUNCIL WAS PLEASED BY THE ELIMINATION OF THE THIEVES IN KOVEL MANSION.

quests.title: The nomads
quests.offer: FIND THE NOMADS AND STOP THEM FROM JOINING FORCES WITH OUR ENEMIES.
quests.report: WE WERE MUCH RELIEVED BY THE NEWS YOU BRING FROM THE NOMAD CAMP.

quests.title: The kobold tribe
quests.offer: A LARGE TRIBE OF KOBOLDS IS BEING RECRUITED BY THE ENEMY.  MAKE SURE THEY DON'T JOIN THE ENEMY FORCES.
quests.done_text: the kobold king dies in his own spiked pit (8:13 0xA502; differential check 14)
quests.report: THIS LOSS OF THE KOBOLD FORCES WILL BE A MAJOR BLOW TO THE ENEMY.

quests.title: The river's pollution
quests.offer: FIND THE SOURCE OF THE RIVER'S POLLUTION AND END IT.
quests.report: WITH THE CLEARING OF THE STOJONOW RIVER, WE CAN OPEN UP THE HINTERLANDS FOR TRADE.

quests.title: The lizardmen
quests.offer: A TRIBE OF LIZARDMEN IS PREPARING TO JOIN THE ENEMY.  PREVENT THIS.
quests.done_text: the old lizard man's cause is won (8:16 0xA362) or the castle is taken (0x9CCF)
quests.report: YOUR ELIMINATION OF THE LIZARDMEN MENACE HAS GREATLY IMPROVED OUR STRATEGIC POSITION.

quests.title: Rescue the Bivant heir
quests.giver: City Council, after Sokal Keep is reported
quests.offer: THE HEIR TO THE HOUSE OF BIVANT MUST BE RESCUED.  WE WILL PAY GENEROUSLY FOR HIS SAFE RETURN.

steps.text: The boy is rescued (the fort taken, the slave pen opened, or bought and taken out)

quests.failed_text: the party ran from the last wave and the boy was left behind (6:1 0xA862); the clerk notes the bungling and the commission closes
quests.report: BIVANT WAS DELIGHTED WITH THE CHILD'S RESCUE.  THEY LEFT SOME TRINKETS FOR YOU.
quests.note: 4AA9 = 1 while the bought boy is with the party (6:1 0xAF3B), 254 once he is out. 4AA9 = 255 also follows a failure ('YOUR BUNGLING THE BIVANT RESCUE HAS COST US.', 0x9E88): a screen tells them apart only if it saw 128 first.

quests.title: Cadorna's message to the Zhentil outpost
quests.giver: Lord Cadorna (City Hall, the south door), once his treasure commission is given
quests.where: 6:28 the Zhentil outpost (west, across the wilderness band 6:25)
quests.offer: LORD CADORNA HAS A DELICATE DIPLOMATIC MISSION THAT REQUIRES YOUR PARTICULAR SKILLS.  YOU ARE SUMMONED TO HIS CHAMBERS. GO THROUGH THE SOUTH DOOR.

steps.text: Cadorna hands over the sealed packet ('DO NOT BREAK THE SEALS')
Out of the outpost
Back on the wilderness band, the mission done

quests.report: WE WERE PLEASANTLY SURPRISED THAT YOU COMPLETED YOUR MISSION SO SWIFTLY.  CADORNA WAS WAGERING YOUR RETURN WOULD BE MUCH DELAYED.
quests.note: Inside the outpost 4AB4 = 1 after the commandant is killed (6:28 0xA2F4); leaving sets 253. Reporting the mission sets 4ABE = 254: Cadorna's treachery is known (next quest). If Cadorna is already exposed, the council gives its own version of the message instead (0xADA6: 4A98 = 255 at once).

quests.title: The traitor Cadorna
quests.where: Valjevo Castle (5:4 the north side, 5:3 the outer castle)

steps.text: Proof of Cadorna's treachery (the swift mission's report, the reports found in Valjevo, 5:4 0xADA6, or the commission list running out of offers, 3:8 0xAF45)
The council declares Cadorna a traitor: 'IF YOU FIND HIM, KILL HIM.'
Cadorna is killed (5:3 0xB19A)

quests.report: THE COUNCIL HAS NOTED THE PASSING OF THE TRAITOR CADORNA.

quests.title: End the graveyard menace
quests.giver: City Council (offered after four major successes, to a strong enough party)
quests.offer: 'I HAVE BEEN AUTHORIZED TO GIVE YOU AN ENCHANTED WEAPON IF YOU ACCEPT THE COMMISSION TO END THE GRAVEYARD MENACE.  DO YOU ACCEPT?'

steps.text: Commission accepted: the enchanted weapon given
The vampire is destroyed

quests.report: THE COUNCIL HAS VOTED A SPECIAL PRIZE FOR ENDING THE GRAVEYARD MENACE.
quests.note: Offered (0xA592) when the tally 4AC1 >= 4, PARTY_STRENGTH >= 19 and the menace is not ended. Undead killed in the graveyard before that are paid at each visit (0x9C58: 0x4A39-0x4A3F against 0x4A8F-0x4A95, the clerk's 'ELIMINATED SOME UNDEAD').

quests.title: Norris the Gray
quests.report: THE COUNCIL HAS AWARDED A BONUS FOR YOUR ELIMINATING NORRIS THE GRAY.

quests.title: Take Stojanow Gate
quests.giver: Lord Urslingen (City Hall, the south door of Cadorna's old quarters), once Cadorna is exposed
quests.offer: LORD URSLINGEN WISHES URGENTLY TO SPEAK WITH YOU.  GO THROUGH THE SOUTH DOOR OF THE TRAITOR CADORNA'S OLD QUARTERS.

steps.text: Urslingen: 'A SMALL BAND MUST SLIP INSIDE AND HOLD UNTIL RELIEVED.'
The gate is taken (2:9 0xA702)

quests.report: YOUR TAKING THE GATE WILL ENABLE OUR FORCES TO ASSAULT THE ENEMY STRONGHOLD. RETURN THERE TO LEAD THE ATTACK.

quests.title: Lead the attack on Valjevo Castle
quests.giver: The City Council in its chambers (a special meeting), once the gate is reported
quests.offer: YOU ARE SUMMONED TO A SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING.  YOU ARE TO BE AWARDED A VALUABLE COMMISSION. THE CITY GUARDS WILL SHOW YOU THE WAY.

steps.text: Tyranthraxus is defeated (5:7 0xA815)

quests.report: CONGRATULATIONS! YOUR QUEST IS OVER! TYRANTHRAXUS IS DEFEATED! PHLAN IS FREE!
quests.note: Known from the gate's report ('RETURN THERE TO LEAD THE ATTACK'), not from 4A9A: the special meeting's flag 4A9A is also written by 7:26 after Yarash's pyramid (0xAF2B 1, 0xAF3B 255, with 4AA2 = 255), so after the pyramid it reads 255 long before any meeting (c34d: from its pyramid checkpoint on) and City Hall skips the meeting's offer (0xAEA5). The original's scripts, not ours.
